paragraphs: Thanks for giving bingd a shot. I built it because the usual 1–5 star ratings never really felt like they captured the experience of watching a good movie or TV show.
Here are a few of my favorite ways to use the app:
Instead of picking a number, compare titles head-to-head and bingd builds your ranked list. That list keeps evolving as you discover new favorites (Avengers: Doomsday anyone?).
My favorite part of the feed is not just seeing what my friends are watching. It's putting those titles in my watchlist and then teasing them about their taste later (The Emoji Movie, really?).

The Group Picks feature (under For you) generates recommendations across multiple bingd users when you're struggling to find a pick before the popcorn runs out. It's a favorite for movie clubs and couples!
If you want to suggest a new feature, find something confusing, or love the app and just want to say hi, you can hit reply to this email. It comes straight to me.
